verdict.rationale: Ironclad's docs and product pages establish a structured CLM workflow — no-code contract creation, workflow launch/approval policies, storage, and e-signature — supporting a controlled process instead of email attachments (ironclad-docs-9, ironclad-docs-15, ironclad-docs-20, ironclad-docs-21, ironclad-docs-8). However, the evidence never explicitly describes redlining/version-comparison or collaborative negotiation features, and community evidence is thin/unrelated (HN threads seem to reference a different tool). Missing for 10: explicit redline/track-changes documentation, negotiation collaboration workflow detail, and independent hands-on corroboration of the redlining experience.
